name: UX Pattern Library
description: Reusable interaction patterns with when-to-use rules. Pick the right pattern and apply the standard behavior.

items.title: Wizard / multi-step form
items.summary: Use for 8+ fields or complex setups. One question per step (or a logical group), progress indicator, back + save draft.
items.content: Break long/complex collections into steps with a clear progress indicator. Each step groups related fields. Always allow going back without losing data and save drafts. Validate per-step so users fix errors immediately.

items.title: Inline editing
items.summary: Edit-in-place for small data changes: click to edit, autosave or explicit save, ESC cancels.
items.content: For single-field or small edits, inline editing beats a dialog. Click value -> input -> save on blur/Enter, ESC cancels. Show saved confirmation subtly. Don't use inline editing for multi-field records.

categories.name: Data Display
categories.description: How to present collections and hierarchies.

items.title: Kanban board
items.summary: Use for stage-based workflows (sales, dev, hiring). Columns = stages, drag between columns, column limits.
items.content: Kanban works when items move through discrete stages. Dragging updates state. Support keyboard alternatives (move via menu). Optional column WIP limits. On mobile, fall back to a list grouped by stage.

items.title: Data table
items.summary: Use for dense comparison/scanning. Sortable columns, filters, pagination, selection, column visibility.
items.content: Tables are for scanning many records. Provide sortable headers, column filters, bulk selection, and configurable columns. Keep one action row per record with primary action always visible. Row detail opens in a drawer/panel for context.

items.title: Timeline
items.summary: Use for chronological activity (audit logs, project history, chat transcripts). Newest first by default.
items.content: Timelines show ordered events with clear timestamps, actor, and action. Group by day. Filter by event type. Provide 'jump to' for long histories. Never overload a single node - a summary with expand is better.

items.title: Dashboard widgets
items.summary: KPI cards with trend, charts that answer a question, and drill-down on click.
items.content: KPI cards: value + delta vs previous period + sparkline. Every widget needs a title and an answerable question. Clicking drills to detail. Keep 4-8 widgets per dashboard - more causes paralysis. Always allow time-range switching.

items.title: Calendar / schedule
items.summary: Day/week/month views, click-to-create with prefilled slot, drag-to-reschedule.
items.content: Support month/week/day views. Clicking an empty slot opens create with that time prefilled. Drag existing events to reschedule. Handle all-day events and time zones correctly.

items.title: Command palette
items.summary: Ctrl/Cmd+K overlay that searches actions, pages, and records; keyboard-first with fuzzy matching.
items.content: The command palette is the power-user hub. One shortcut opens it, type to fuzzy-match, arrows to navigate sections, Enter to run. Show grouped results (Actions / Pages / Records) with icons and shortcuts.

items.title: Search behavior
items.summary: Instant results with debounce, highlight matches, recent searches, and empty-result guidance.
items.content: Search should feel instant (debounce ~250ms). Show matched terms highlighted, recent searches first, then results. On no results, offer suggestions or a clear 'try these terms'. Global search covers records + actions.

categories.name: Actions & Flows
categories.description: Bulk, drag, approval and conversation interactions.

items.title: Bulk actions
items.summary: Multi-select shows a sticky toolbar with count; dangerous bulk actions get a confirmation.
items.content: Selecting multiple rows reveals a toolbar (count + actions). Support select-all. Destructive bulk actions (bulk delete) require explicit confirmation with the count. Provide undo where possible.

items.title: Drag & drop
items.summary: Provide visual feedback, snap targets, drop indicators, and keyboard alternatives for every drop.
items.content: Drag-and-drop needs clear affordance (grab handle), live feedback while dragging, snap-zone highlighting, and a keyboard path (move menu). Never make functionality only available via drag.

items.title: Approval flow
items.summary: Submit -> notify approver -> approve/reject with reason -> notify submitter. Deadlines and escalation.
items.content: Approvals: submitter sees status; approver gets notified with full context and a decision (with reason if rejected). Add SLA deadlines with escalation reminders. Rejection gives a clear reason and next step.

items.title: Chat interface
items.summary: For conversations: message bubbles, typing indicator, timestamps, attachments, and persistence.
items.content: Chat keeps history persistent, shows sender + timestamp, typing indicator, and supports attachments/emojis where appropriate. Provide search within conversation. Unread counts and notifications matter for async team chat.

items.title: Notifications
items.summary: In-app bell with unread counts, toast for ephemeral feedback, per-type preferences, and digest option.
items.content: Three kinds: in-app feed (persistent), toasts (ephemeral success/errors), and push/email (optional). Users control which types they receive. Batch emails into a digest to avoid noise.
